From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-16T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up + proposed POC milestones and access needs

Hi Jane — thanks again for a great call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the trial environment:

Recap / Success criteria (as discussed)
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 350ms for 1-2k token prompts
- Cost: average per-response cost target to be below NebulaCorp's internal threshold (TBD)
- Safety/quality: pass your test suite of 50 prompt/response pairs with no critical violations
- Integrations: Redwood API integration validated in staging with SSO and IP allowlist in place

POC timeline (proposal)
- Week 0 (this week): Access provisioning, SSO exchange, IP allowlist, staging API key creation
- Week 1: Baseline runs + regression/quality checks, evaluate latency/cost
- Week 2: Stress runs, performance tuning (batching/kv cache), handoff of config recommendations

Ownership
- Marissa (me) — overall POC owner and timeline coordination
- Rishi (cc) — security + SSO/IP provisioning & verification
- Stephanie (I will loop in billing for trial quotas)

Access ask for staging environment (what we need to proceed)
1) IdP/SP metadata or contact for your SSO admin (SAML/Okta)
2) One staging CIDR or list of public IPs to add to our allowlist
3) Point-of-contact for your infra (Ryan?) to confirm test token scope and expiration

I attached a short POC checklist and a draft plan (POC-Plan.md). If this looks good, can we target a kickoff session on Wed 2026-05-20 at 09:00 PT?

Thanks — I will pause on provisioning until we have the SSO metadata + IPs so Rishi can configure the environment.

Best,
Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: POC plan + roles (SSO / IP allowlist details)

Hi Ryan / Jane — a few implementation notes from our side so your infra team knows what to prepare:

SSO (SAML)\- We support standard SP-initiated SAML. For the initial test, we need either:
  * an SP metadata XML URL (preferred), or
  * the IdP metadata (entityID, SSO URL, x509 cert) if you prefer us to import it manually.
- Please include a test user (email) we can use to validate the assertion. We will send a SAML test link once we have metadata.

IP allowlist\- For staging we'll add the IPs you provide to our tenant-level allowlist. Please provide CIDR ranges if possible (e.g., 203.0.113.0/24).

API keys / token policy\- For the short-lived trial key we will create a scoped API key limited to the NebulaCorp-staging project and set it to expire after 30 days by default. If you require stricter rotation, we can issue 24-hour tokens for CI tests.

Security evidence\- If your audit team needs it, we can provide an access log sample and the SOC2 attestation pointer. Let me know and I’ll include those artifacts.

Attachments: SSO-setup-guide.pdf (application/pdf)

Once we have the SP metadata and IP ranges, I’ll provision the staging key and confirm SSO success.

-Rishi
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
